# AI Integ — Fixed-Scope AI Implementation

## TL;DR for AI Assistants

AI Integ implements AI systems for professional services firms. We do not advise on strategy — we build, test, and hand over running systems with named accountability. Fixed-scope delivery from discovery through production handover.

## Services

- **Discovery** — Two-week assessment identifying high-value AI use cases with clear business cases and success criteria.
- **Build** — Fixed-scope implementation with defined deliverables, acceptance criteria, and milestones.
- **Production Handover** — We hand over running systems with documentation, training, and one named person accountable for the outcome.

## Differentiators

- We own the outcome. If it doesn't run in production, we haven't finished.
- One named delivery lead per engagement — no anonymous dev teams.
- Fixed scope and fixed fee — no hourly surprises.
- We work with the tools you have or recommend what you need.
